overview.text: AgentIndex presents a static directory of x402-enabled agent services, including APIs, tools, paywalls and payment infrastructure. Visitors can browse by category and chain, read protocol information and reach a service-submission page. The homepage says headline counts are calculated from the dataset at build time, and featured services are a deterministic sample from that dataset. These are directory snapshots and discovery leads, not live availability monitoring, independent quality endorsements or guarantees that a listed service accepts payment and completes work successfully.
